supplemental_parsed.reason_unreviewed: 证据支持Trimmomatic能够执行质量修剪（quality filtering），且Sliding Window（SW）是其质量修剪模式之一（D01:S04, D01:S08）。D01:S02提供了Sliding Window算法的具体机制（扫描5'端，当平均质量低于阈值时移除3'端），支持目标引用中关于“使用滑动窗口切割等算法进行质量修剪”的主张。证据未直接提及“popular”（流行）这一属性，也未直接证明其是“adapter tool”（尽管D01:S08提到adapter removal步骤，但目标引用主要强调其作为修剪工具执行质量修剪的能力，且D01:S04明确将其与质量模式关联）。

2.2.1 Sliding Window quality filtering
The Sliding Window uses
a relatively standard approach. This works by scanning from the
5′ end of the read, and removes the 3′ end of the read when the
average quality of a group of bases drops below a specified
threshold.

2.2.1 Sliding Window quality filtering
The Sliding Window uses
a relatively standard approach. This works by scanning from the
50 end of the read, and removes the 30 end of the read when the
average quality of a group of bases drops below a specified
threshold.
